classification.difficultyReason: Select familiar polynomial division, retain symbolic coefficients through subtraction, and interpret exact divisibility as requiring both coefficients of the linear remainder to vanish. Both parts require the same routine linkage.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If $x^4-x^3-10x^2+mx+n$ is exactly divisible by $x^2-3x+1$, find $m$ and $n$.

answer.short: $m=17$, $n=-5$. Long division gives remainder $(m-17)x+(n+5)$; exact divisibility requires both coefficients to be zero.
answer.worked:
The successive quotient terms in long division are $x^2$, $2x$ and $-5$.
$$\begin{aligned}
(x^4-x^3-10x^2+mx+n)-x^2(x^2-3x+1)&=2x^3-11x^2+mx+n\\
(2x^3-11x^2+mx+n)-2x(x^2-3x+1)&=-5x^2+(m-2)x+n\\
(-5x^2+(m-2)x+n)-(-5)(x^2-3x+1)&=(m-17)x+(n+5).
\end{aligned}$$
Thus
$$\begin{aligned}
x^4-x^3-10x^2+mx+n&=(x^2-3x+1)(x^2+2x-5)+(m-17)x+(n+5).
\end{aligned}$$
Exact divisibility means the remainder is zero, so
$$\begin{aligned}
m-17&=0\\
n+5&=0\\
m&=17,\qquad n=-5.
\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If $x^4+3x^3-9x^2+mx+n$ is exactly divisible by $x^2+5x-2$, find $m$ and $n$.

answer.short: $m=19$, $n=-6$. Long division gives remainder $(m-19)x+(n+6)$; exact divisibility requires both coefficients to be zero.
answer.worked:
The successive quotient terms in long division are $x^2$, $-2x$ and $3$.
$$\begin{aligned}
(x^4+3x^3-9x^2+mx+n)-x^2(x^2+5x-2)&=-2x^3-7x^2+mx+n\\
(-2x^3-7x^2+mx+n)-(-2x)(x^2+5x-2)&=3x^2+(m-4)x+n\\
(3x^2+(m-4)x+n)-3(x^2+5x-2)&=(m-19)x+(n+6).
\end{aligned}$$
Thus
$$\begin{aligned}
x^4+3x^3-9x^2+mx+n&=(x^2+5x-2)(x^2-2x+3)+(m-19)x+(n+6).
\end{aligned}$$
Exact divisibility means the remainder is zero, so
$$\begin{aligned}
m-19&=0\\
n+6&=0\\
m&=19,\qquad n=-6.
\end{aligned}$$
